task: T-125 — sweep the row phases of C-0055's upward arm array
conditions: T = 300 K, k_BT = 4.141947 pN nm; aqueous 2 mM MgCl2; 40.0 x 40.35 nm single-layer square-lattice Rothemund sheet, 15 duplexes at 2.69 nm; C-0039's 8.164 nm arm at C-0055's self-consistent 34 roots; C-0017's 33.3333 pN/nm mandate; C-0022's solved profile at 2 mM, a 10 nm gap and 0.192 V; C-0001's foundation secant
decision: the best 34-root placement dishes 0.0706 of the stroke; T-5b's convention is 0.10 and the free tile is 0.3079

findings: The best 34-root placement the upward lattice can supply dishes 0.0706 of the stroke under C-0022's solved load, against the free tile's 0.3079 on the same host, C-0055's own placement at 0.4156 and C-0058's 3 x 15 at 0.0753. It is INSIDE T-5b's 0.10 and it beats no coupling at all.

The placement is at phase 24 of 32, is centro-symmetric, and its coupling centroid is 0.000 nm against C-0055's -8.80. Exactly 2 of the 32 phases can supply a centro-symmetric placement at all, and they are 8 and 24 — which is a congruence, 2c = 0 (mod p), and not a search.

C-0061's mirrored placement is NOT on the upward lattice: 16 of its 16 reflected odd-row roots are not upward sites at all, and 16 of them are WEST sites — the DOWNWARD azimuth, which points into the grafted layer and which C-0055 counted and refused. Its 0.3558 and 0.1649 are quoted on a station set the array cannot supply.

The distribution question, settled on a placement that exists: C-0058's one-parameter rim family reaches 0.0706 on the best placement, its 34-parameter descent 0.0608, and the least-squares floor over ALL force vectors — a rigorous lower bound on every distribution whatever — is 0.0031. On C-0055's own placement the same floor is 0.0116.

The host's phase and the array's phase are ONE variable. C-0061 read C-0055's phase-0 roots on the nominal eight-column host, which is the phase-8 lattice; on its own seven-column host the same 34 roots dish 0.5771 against 0.4156, a departure of 38.9 %.
